description: TIE Gold Standard engine for wind and solar lease negotiation, structure analysis, royalty calculations, surface use conflicts, tax incentive analysis, and landowner protection in renewable energy land transactions.
author: ECHO OMEGA PRIME

confidence_levels.DEFENSIBLE: Position supported by statute, regulation, or established case law with high certainty
confidence_levels.AGGRESSIVE: Position supportable but involves interpretation risk or untested application
confidence_levels.DISCLOSURE: Material uncertainty requiring explicit disclosure to client or counterparty
confidence_levels.HIGH_RISK: Position with substantial litigation or regulatory challenge risk

response_modes.FAST: Concise answer with key lease terms and critical provisions
response_modes.DEFENSE: Full analysis with authority citations, risk assessment, and defensive drafting
response_modes.MEMO: Complete memorandum with background, analysis, conclusion, and recommended lease language

analysis_zones.NEGOTIATION: Active lease negotiation and term structuring
analysis_zones.COMPLIANCE: Regulatory compliance, permitting, and environmental review
analysis_zones.DISPUTE: Conflict resolution, accommodation doctrine, surface use disputes
